scope: Fail-closed Core3-equivalent primary hit-or-miss calculation for authenticated Pre-CU combat commands. Secondary outcomes are governed by the separate secondary-defense contract.

semanticReference.equation: Starting at 75, apply up to three nonlinear 25-point steps to (attackerAccuracy - targetDefense) / 50, then clamp to 0..100.

fallbackPolicy.nonOptedCommand: existing NGE attacker and defender result tables
fallbackPolicy.zeroOrMissingAccuracyBonus: existing NGE attacker and defender result tables
fallbackPolicy.missingWeaponProfile: existing NGE attacker and defender result tables
fallbackPolicy.authenticatedPrimaryPath: Core3 primary hit-or-miss result with the NGE defender table bypassed so the two systems are never blended
fallbackPolicy.reason: A partial row must never silently create a Core3/NGE hybrid hit equation.

included: weapon and ranged accuracy skill mods
Core3 private accuracy bonuses used by the unbuffed fixture
ranged attack and defense locomotion modifiers
defender level, ranged defense, private defense, group defense, and dodge-attack bonuses
deferred: secondary outcomes outside the separately authenticated secondary-defense profiles

buildEvidence.environment: isolated swg-precu Linux build volume with exact staged files

requiredBeforeReady: live status exposes the computed Core3 accuracy components and chance for the authenticated fixture
ideal-range and max-range fixture placements produce the modeled chances
an authenticated attack uses the Core3 primary result and reports the observed hit or miss
a non-opted command demonstrably retains the NGE result path
fixture cleanup restores all owned position, weapon, skill, combat, and HAM state
